name: Parsec for Teams
summary: Parsec for Teams connects team members directly to shared or personal computers over encrypted peer-to-peer links. The Teams plan lists $30 per user a month billed annually, with an admin dashboard, SSO and audit logs for the last 7 days. Enterprise is sold by quote and adds full audit logs through the API and SCIM provisioning.

facts.text: The Parsec for Teams page says the product connects keyboard, mouse and gamepad input to a remote computer, and that team members can access shared workstations on demand.
The page says connections are encrypted and peer-to-peer, and that work does not pass through a server.
The Teams plan lists an admin panel, centralized billing, team managed groups and computers, single sign-on, and audit logs for the last 7 days.
The Enterprise plan adds the Teams API, a high performance relay server, role-based access, full audit logs through the Teams API and SCIM provisioning.
The page says the Personal Use and Individuals plans are licensed for personal, non-commercial use only. Commercial use needs a Teams or Enterprise plan.
Guest access for external users is listed on the Teams plan at $25 per invitation.

plans.name: Personal Use
plans.notes: Free, for personal non-commercial use only. Not licensed for commercial use.

plans.name: Teams
plans.unit: per user per month, billed annually
plans.notes: The page shows $30 per user a month with the annual option selected, and $35 a month on monthly billing. Includes SSO, audit logs for 7 days and guest access at $25 per invitation.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: The page shows no price. It adds the Teams API, role-based access, full audit logs and SCIM provisioning.

hiddenCosts: The Parsec for Teams page does not name its currency. The figures use the dollar sign.
Guest access for external users costs $25 per invitation on the Teams plan.
